basic_details.job_title: UDD Uttarakhand Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Urban Infrastructure Expert, Urban Planner and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Urban Infrastructure Expert (Water Supply) State, Urban Planner (State), MIS Expert (State), District Mission Manager (Urban), Cluster Urban Planner
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the application fee, the age limit, the pay or the selection process.

qualification.details: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. See the details on the official website for the eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Get the details of the posts from the UDD website, as the advertisement directs.
Submit your application before the closing time on the last date.

content_sections.heading: About UDD
content_sections.text: The Urban Development Directorate is a Government of Uttarakhand office at 31/62 Rajpur Road, Dehradun. This recruitment is for its Project Management Unit (PMU) and Project Implement Unit (PIU) under AMRUT 2.0.

rows.link: Email id printed on the letterhead

faq.question: Q1. Which posts are in the Project Management Unit?
faq.answer: The PMU has 3 state-level posts: Urban Infrastructure Expert (Water Supply) State, Urban Planner (State) and MIS Expert (State), with 1 post each.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are in the Project Implement Unit?
faq.answer: The PIU has 3 posts of District Mission Manager (Urban) and 2 posts of Cluster Urban Planner.

faq.question: Q3. What time do applications close on the last date?
faq.answer: Applications must be in by 17:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. Are these permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement describes the engagement as purely contractual, under AMRUT 2.0.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I get more details about these posts?
faq.answer: The advertisement says details can be obtained from www.udd.uk.gov.in.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the UDD office?
faq.answer: The office is at 31/62 Rajpur Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand - 248001.
